Questions

What is “true monthly cost”?

List price plus a public IPv4 address, backups (where you tick them) and bandwidth overage at the egress you choose. EUR plans are converted at an approximate rate shown on the methodology page.

Why are some rows unverified?

On the check date we could not read every number from the official page (client-rendered tables, ambiguous promo display). We show the row and leave unknowns blank rather than guess.

Do promos count?

We rank on the regular/renewal (no-commitment) price. Intro and term/prepay prices (e.g. OVH 12-mo prepay) are shown alongside and labeled — a prepaid year rate is not the month-to-month bill.

How often is data checked?

A script snapshots every source page weekly and diffs it; confirmed changes go into the dated price log.

Do affiliate links change rankings?

There are no affiliate links today, and ranking is by computed cost only. If we ever add affiliate links they will be labeled and will not change the order.
